praise: Fraunces + Inter pairing with a tight scale (hero clamp 2.6–4.6rem, h2 1.7–2.5rem) gives real display/body rhythm; no system-font fallback smell, tagline capped at 640px keeps lines comfortable

Color discipline is excellent: restrained coffee-brown + gold on cream is unmistakably crafted for a coffee stand, with gradients used only as tonal depth (hero, about-card, CTA banner) rather than rainbow soup

Hierarchy is correct — badge, name+offer, one sentence, one dominant CTA (tel) threaded through topbar, sticky header, hero, about-card, CTA banner and footer — a visitor can name the business, the offer, and how to reach it in seconds
Specific, real copy: full street address, phone, 'takeout ready in about 15 minutes', 'whole-bean bags ground to your brewer', 'coffee boxes and pastry trays' — concrete, not adjective filler
